current_reader_reuse_audit.stream_handle_policy: At most one idle independently opened synchronous file per immutable segment and 128 idle files per store. Borrow removes a file from the cache; queries retain exclusive ownership. Segment lifetime governs retirement. Full verification opens fresh files and clears idle files on failure. Every streamed payload block is read and CRC-checked; indexed-page caching retains its preceding behavior.
